relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Trpv1 and Trpv4 transcripts were significantly upregulated in the DRG of CIPN rats compared to controls

relationships.subject: evodiamine
relationships.evidence_quote: evodiamine treatment selectively inhibited the upregulation of Trpv1 in paclitaxel-induced CIPN rats without affecting Trpv4 expression

relationships.subject: evodiamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Evodiamine treatment significantly attenuated this paclitaxel-induced upregulation of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and MCP-1 in DRG tissues

relationships.subject: evodiamine
relationships.evidence_quote: evodiamine treatment significantly increased the proportion of CD206-positive M2 macrophages while decreasing the population of CD86-positive M1 macrophages

relationships.subject: p38 MAPK
relationships.evidence_quote: p-p38MAPK can upregulate TRPV1 expression at the transcriptional level

relationships.subject: evodiamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Evodiamine administration significantly reduces p38 MAPK phosphorylation and inhibits TRPV1 upregulation.

relationships.subject: evodiamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Evodiamine dose-dependently alleviated paclitaxel-induced mechanical and thermal allodynia both acutely and preventively.

key_findings: Evodiamine relieved paclitaxel-induced allodynia and selectively blocked TRPV1 (not TRPV4) upregulation in DRG, with reduced TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6 and MCP-1.
Evodiamine shifted DRG macrophages from M1 to M2 and reduced p38 MAPK phosphorylation, which drives TRPV1 promoter activity.
